evidence: Plaut. As. 1.3.20: pār parī datum hostīmentum est (Lewis & Short s.v. hostīmentum)
Plaut. Pers. 2.2.41: pār parī respondēs dictō, you return tit for tat (Lewis & Short s.v. respondeō)
Ter. Phorm. 1.4.35: verbum verbō pār parī ut respondeās (Lewis & Short s.v. respondeō)
terms.comment: Comedy’s phrase for a retort in kind, with parī dative; Lewis & Short gives pār prō parī referre in the same sense (s.v. pār).

sources: Lewis & Short: respondeo · Lewis & Short: par
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, cited by printed page; each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
